output.question: What is CDW's annual revenue?
output.answer: CDW's latest reported annual revenue, using the company's reported net sales measure, was $22.4241 billion for the year ended December 31, 2025. This was up 6.8% from $20.9987 billion in 2024; as of November 11, 2026, the 2025 full-year result is the most recent annual figure available in the opened company release.

key_facts.fact: CDW reported net sales of $22,424.1 million for the year ended December 31, 2025.
CDW reported net sales of $20,998.7 million for 2024 and a 6.8% year-over-year increase in 2025.

passages.quote: Net sales in 2025 were $22,424 million, compared to $20,999 million in 2024, an increase of 6.8 percent.

caveats: CDW labels the top-line measure in this release as net sales rather than revenue; the figures are presented in millions of U.S. dollars.
The 2026 fiscal year was not complete as of November 11, 2026, so no full-year 2026 annual figure was available in the opened source.
